contract: The page must expose window.game.state() returning { player: {x, y}, tiles: { 'x,y': { crop, stage } }, inventory: { seeds, crops }, day }.

steps.name: loads with no page or console errors and exposes state
steps.expect: errors.length === 0 && state && state.player && typeof state.player.x === 'number' && state.tiles && state.inventory && typeof state.day === 'number'

steps.name: ArrowRight still moves the player right
p still plants on an empty tile and spends a seed
steps.expect: (function(){ const k = state.player.x + ',' + state.player.y; return !!state.tiles[k] && state.inventory.seeds === before.inventory.seeds - 1; })()

steps.name: t advances the day by one, grows every planted tile by one stage, and creates no tile
steps.expect: (function(){ const k = state.player.x + ',' + state.player.y; const sameKeys = JSON.stringify(Object.keys(state.tiles).sort()) === JSON.stringify(Object.keys(before.tiles).sort()); return state.day === before.day + 1 && state.tiles[k] && state.tiles[k].stage === before.tiles[k].stage + 1 && sameKeys; })()

steps.name: repeated t stops growing at stage 3 and does not run past it
steps.expect: (function(){ const k = state.player.x + ',' + state.player.y; return state.tiles[k] && state.tiles[k].stage === 3 && state.day === before.day + 4; })()

steps.name: repeated t still neither creates nor removes a tile
